segments.name: Oil refining
segments.description: Operates a regional refinery producing refined fuel and asphalt products from crude oil, with a development-stage waste asphalt shingle recycling division.
segments.evidence: We operate a regional refinery (the Eagle Springs Refinery) producing diesel, vacuum gas oil (VGO), naphtha and liquid paving asphalt from crude oil suppliers in the Uintah basin near Nevada and Utah.
